title: A worker that declares nothing is restarted without freezing a film it was making
description: JS-161 measures a worker's speed before it registers (bound 15 s; 6.1 to 7.6 s on a CI runner), so a replacement that declares nothing registers after the 6 s a waiting segment request is given, and on a cluster with no other worker with room the request is refused: before playback has begun jellyfin-web asks again, after it has begun the picture freezes. A worker that declares its capacity registers at once. D-060 (option C): a replacement registers at once for work already admitted and counts nothing for new plays until measured. PRODUCT.md: upgrades and a lost machine interrupt no one.
acceptanceCriteria: With real processes and workers that declare nothing: a film is playing as a re-encode on the only worker; the worker stops and its replacement starts 3 seconds after a segment request, with its measurement held to the full bound. The waiting request is answered with the segment, not 503, and playback goes on. This is test/roles.sh's restart check, undeclared, and it fails on JS-161 as merged.

Until its measurement ends, the replacement admits no new play on a guess. A play asked for in that window is admitted once measured, or refused within seconds with its reason; it is never admitted and then stalled.
A reclaimed job the replacement turns out not to hold at 1.2 times real time is logged once with its reason and counted (JS-161 criterion 7's line); it is not stopped.
docs/running.md drops the advice to declare capacity for restarts and docs/status.md drops the gap line. The Changed guarantees entry of D-060 is closed.
notes: Dropped 2026-11-23 by D-062: JS-161 merges without a start-up measurement, so its gap never ships; its criterion 1 is JS-161 criterion 12.
